 Derek Hough Shares Heartbreaking News as ‘DWTS’ Family Rallies Around Him
 ‘Dancing with the Stars’ judge Derek Hough mourns the difficult loss of a beloved companion he had for 14 years.
 Published
 8 minutes ago on
 October 25, 2026 
 By
 Stacy Carey 
 Add Closer on Google 
 Derek Hough is a judge on 'Dancing with the Stars.' Disney 
 Dancing with the Stars judge Derek Hough is navigating a deeply heartbreaking loss, and he is receiving a great deal of love and support from the DWTS family. His dog, Romie, has died, and Hough is devastated.
 Hough shared a touching post on Instagram where he opened up about the time he shared with Romie. The video began, “14 years by my side. I miss you so much already. My heart aches. Goodbye my son. I will love you forever.”
 The Dancing with the Stars judge added quite a bit more in a sweet caption. He explained, “Romie came into my life when I was just trying to figure life out, it was just me and him.”
 He noted that Romie saw Hough at both his best and his worst and loved him through all of it. Hough shared that Romie “somehow gave me purpose when I couldn’t find it myself.”
 Romie watched Hough fall in love and get married to Hayley Erbert , and “when he started to get tired, I asked him to hold on so he could meet his little sister, and he kept his promise.”
 As People noted, the couple’s first child, Everley Capri Hough, was born in December 2025.
 Disney 
 “Waking up without him feels unreal,” Hough admitted. He sees the spot by the bushes in the yard where he’d often see Romie walk, and he’s struggling to accept he won’t see that again.
 Hough added, “But thank you, my boy, for choosing us, for carrying me, for giving me so much.”
 Although Hough wrote that he feels “an ache that feels unbearable,” he also recognizes, “It’s also proof that love lived here fully. And you always will.”
 “Goodbye for now my sweet sweet Romie Boy,” Hough shared.
 In one of Hough’s Instagram Stories , the Dancing with the Stars judge included a photo showing him with Romie in front of a “Dog Adoption” sign, a glimpse of the day they met and began building a life together.
 Within just the first hour of the post being live on Instagram, Hough received over 75,000 “likes” as fans and colleagues showed their support, along with over 6,000 comments.
 Season 35 Dancing with the Stars contestant Jenna Dewan wrote, “Ohhhh i know this pain so well. Romie is your angel spirit now, still with you.”
 Fellow contestant Amber Glenn added, “I’m so sorry. Nothing aches like the pain of loosing (sic) your furry friend.”
 Other comments came from Erbert’s mom, Debbie Schwartz, as well as Sasha Farber , Pasha Pashkov , Emma Slater , and Brooks Laich , who used to be married to Hough’s sister, Dancing with the Stars co-host Julianne Hough .
 Hough’s former Dancing with the Stars partner, Amy Purdy , wrote, “I’m so sorry, Derek. Nothing is harder than saying goodbye to your best friend who’s been by your side through so many chapters. Dogs truly are angels on earth, and somehow seem to know when their work here is done. Sending you and Hayley so much love.”
